name: Threefold
summary: A freelancer money app that splits every payment into Spend, Tax and Save pots
about: A seven-page money app for freelancers and small studios, made of soft clay-like panels in mist or slate. One bar with two draggable handles sets how each payment splits into Spend, Tax and Save, and every new payment flows as a forking stream into three bubbles that grow with their balance. Pots, spending, moves between pots, tax payments and reports all work, with sample data in rupees.
how: Open a page from the sidebar: Home, Split rule, Income, Pots, Spending, Reports or Settings
On Split rule, drag the two handles (or use the arrow keys) and preview any payment
Add a payment and watch it fork into the three pots while the bubbles grow
Move money between pots, pay a tax bill from the Tax pot, or record spending from Spend
Switch the Reports range to see the pot balances morph
Press Ctrl+K to jump, edit starting balances and reset demo data in Settings
